title: Italian Wedding Soup
description: Tiny Parmesan meatballs simmered in chicken broth with small pasta, carrots and spinach. A cozy, complete meal in a bowl.

image.alt: A bowl of wedding soup with tiny meatballs, greens and pasta

items.item: small pasta such as acini di pepe or orzo

steps.text: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, egg, garlic and salt with your hands until just combined. Roll into small meatballs about {len 3/4 in} across; you’ll get about {count 40}.
Heat the oil in the pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery until soft, {time 8 min}.
Add the broth and bring to a boil. Drop in the meatballs one at a time, lower the heat and simmer gently until they float and are cooked through, {time 10 min}.
Stir in the pasta and simmer until tender, {time 8-10 min}. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, {time 1 min}. Taste for salt and serve with extra Parmesan.

notes: Roll the meatballs with damp hands so the mixture doesn’t stick.
Freeze the soup without the pasta; add freshly cooked pasta when reheating.
